post.summary: Set a command to its defaults
post.description:
Set a command to its defaults

**Endpoint:** `POST /restconf/operations/rpc:default`

rpc:default.description: YANG choice — mutually exclusive case groups: choice 'default-choice' (mandatory): interface-case.

result.description: Output returned by the network element

lockout.description: Clear locked out local AAA users

iox.description: Clear all IOX data to the default, initial IOX state

rpc:clear.description: YANG choice — mutually exclusive case groups: choice 'clear-choice' (mandatory): interface-case | count-case | ip-case | arp-cache-case | aaa-case | platform-case | iox-case.

           irreversible operation
